baslik: The Volcano That Erupted During World War II

sahneler.metin: This volcano erupted in the middle of World War Two.
Lava swallowed whole villages while Allied troops looked on.
March 1944. Vesuvius, the volcano that buried Pompeii, wakes up.
Rivers of lava crawl down its slopes into the towns.
Falling ash wrecks dozens of American bombers at a nearby airfield.
Families flee, carrying whatever they can.
Two villages are wiped off the map.
It was the last time Vesuvius erupted. It is only sleeping.
